<!-- Source page: Parsedmarc -->

[parsedmarc](https://domainaware.github.io/parsedmarc/) is is a Python module and CLI utility for parsing DMARC reports.

It is documented in the [NixOS manual](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#module-services-parsedmarc).
